versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -E JAB'
    CommandLine|contains: '--load-extension="*\Appdata\local\chrome"'
    Image|endswith: '\chrome.exe'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\powershell.exe" ParentCommandLine="*-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -E JAB*" CommandLine="*--load-extension=\"*\\Appdata\\local\\chrome\"*" Image="*\\chrome.exe"
